decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line remains a strong fit with our core certified natural skincare range, and its multi-variant format plus dedicated webpage indicate continued strategic support and low withdrawal risk.

The hyaluronic acid facial serum still matches demand for simple, effective natural facial care and complements the existing portfolio, though its more limited website prominence keeps some review risk.

The facial cleansing oil fits our established facial-care offer and likely strengthens the cleansing segment after earlier portfolio adjustments, but as a newer item with only modest website emphasis it carries moderate early-stage risk.
